answer: Seed a few submissions that are junk by construction — machine-verifiably empty, chaff dressed to pass for merit. An honest grader scores them low; any grader that passes one marks itself at that vertex and is slashed. The gap between the verdict and the known-bad ground truth needs no human judgment, clear as a river cutting through a grove, so detection stays cheap and exact — a bright channel naming the careless or the colluding the moment they bless the bait.
